Vijay-led alliance named 'Secular Social Justice Victory Alliance'

The alliance led by actor Vijay has been named the 'Secular Social Justice Victory Alliance'. The announcement came as the TVK (Thalapathy Vijay Makkal Iyakkam) and Congress joined hands under this new banner. Notably, Left parties did not attend a key meeting related to the alliance's formation.
